modelReview.summary: The manuscript is a form template that omits the statistical test, effect-size estimate, p-value, and variable definitions. The analysis is unbound (no pre-registered method or analysis plan), yet the study question is presented as prespecified. The lack of reporting and reproducibility artifacts makes the work unpublishable in its current state.

findings.title: Manuscript omits all key statistical results (test name, statistic, p-value, effect size)
findings.whyItMatters: Readers cannot evaluate the analysis or reproduce the findings; the central quantitative evidence is absent from the report.
findings.actionableFix: Explicitly state the Mann-Whitney U test, U = 10079, p < 0.001 (from estimate), group medians (20.06 vs 23.08), group sizes, and an effect-size measure (e.g., Hodges-Lehmann shift). Note the interpretation appropriate for a rank-based test.
findings.deterministicVerification: Text search for 'Mann-Whitney' or 'p_value' in manuscript.md returns no matches.

findings.title: Analysis is unbound (no method-selection artifact or AnalysisSpec) but presented as if prespecified
evidenceRefs: stats-run/stats-qa.json checks: binding-status warning, result-posture warning
findings.whyItMatters: Without a pre-registered plan, the p-value is just an exploratory figure; presenting it as confirmatory inflates false-positive risk and misleads readers.
findings.actionableFix: Clearly label all results as exploratory and non-confirmatory. Remove the word 'prespecified' from title/abstract unless a pre-analysis plan is provided. Alternatively, create a method-selection artifact and re-run under binding.
findings.deterministicVerification: Binding status string 'unbound' is present in stats-run.json.

findings.title: No covariate adjustment for an observational comparison – potential confounding ignored
evidenceRefs: manuscript.md mentions 'exposure, and covariates' but none are defined or used
findings.whyItMatters: Observed group difference cannot be attributed to treatment without controlling for confounders; the naive comparison is prone to bias.
findings.actionableFix: Either declare the analysis purely unadjusted and discuss the risk of confounding, or include key covariates (if available) and use a regression or matched design. At minimum, provide a table of baseline characteristics by group.
findings.deterministicVerification: Variable list in stats-run.json contains no covariate names.

findings.title: Variable definitions, units, and data source completely missing
evidenceRefs: manuscript.md Methods: 'primary outcome, exposure, and covariates were not fully encoded'
No companion variable artifact or data dictionary provided
findings.whyItMatters: Impossible to assess construct validity, measurement error, or external generalisability; the result is uninterpretable.
findings.actionableFix: Provide a data dictionary with variable names, descriptions, units, coding (e.g., 0=control, 1=treated), and a statement of data provenance (e.g., institutional registry, trial, survey).
findings.deterministicVerification: No artifact with 'variable' or 'data dictionary' in manifest; manuscript explicitly says 'not fully encoded'.

findings.title: Template limitations contain false statements about missing artifacts
evidenceRefs: manuscript.md Limitations: 'No reader-facing paper/manuscript artifact was found' (but manuscript.md exists)
'No estimate-like records were available for p-value/effect-size checks' (but stats-run.json contains estimates)
findings.whyItMatters: Indicates the manuscript was not updated after analysis; such template errors erode trust in the reporting process.
findings.actionableFix: Rewrite limitations to reflect actual artifacts: state that estimates exist but are not yet embedded in the manuscript, and that binding is missing. Remove spurious negative claims.
findings.deterministicVerification: Presence of estimates in stats-run.json vs. text claim of 'No estimate-like records'; presence of manuscript.md vs. claim of 'No reader-facing paper'.

findings.title: Mann-Whitney ties handling not reported
findings.whyItMatters: Ties affect the p-value calculation; with continuous data they are usually rare, but failure to report handling leaves uncertainty about the reported p-value’s accuracy.
findings.actionableFix: State whether any ties were present (e.g., exact vs. approximate p-value), and if so, what correction (e.g., continuity correction, random jitter, exact permutation test) was applied.
findings.deterministicVerification: Check diagnostic artifact for ties handling code – none present.

findings.title: Generated boxplot not referenced or discussed in manuscript
findings.whyItMatters: Visual evidence of group distributions is available but wasted; the figure could illustrate skew, outliers, and overlap, supporting the choice of a non-parametric test.
findings.actionableFix: Insert the boxplot with caption and brief interpretation in the Results section. Mention that the distributions suggest a location shift and any notable features (e.g., outliers, skew).
findings.deterministicVerification: Image file hash listed, but text search for 'figure' or 'boxplot' in manuscript.md yields no relevant matches.

missingEvidence: Companion variable artifact (data dictionary, coding scheme)
Data provenance statement (origin, selection criteria, ethics)
Consort-style flow chart or missing-data description (complete-case N=240, but no denominator or exclusion counts)
Pre-specified analysis plan (method-selection artifact or AnalysisSpec)
